title: carlina libanotica subsp. microcephala
intro: Carlina libanotica subsp. microcephala, commonly known as Lebanese Edelweiss, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Carlina libanotica subsp. microcephala are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, such as costunolide and dehydrocostus lactone, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant also include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
